name: spreadsheetFromJson
description: Creates a new spreadsheet workbook from a JSON array. An array of objects becomes a header row (the keys of the first object) followed by one data row per object; an array of arrays becomes a raw grid of cells. The fluent member form is fromJson(json), which replaces the contents of the active sheet.

params.name: json
params.description: A JSON string: an array of row objects or an array of arrays of cell values.

examples.title: Objects to workbook
examples.description: A JSON array of objects becomes a header row plus data rows.

examples.title: Arrays to workbook
examples.description: A JSON array of arrays becomes a raw grid.
